versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Add pyautogui

- Clarified that login is only required for the creator center (creator.xiaohongshu.com) in VNC; logging into the main site is not needed for long-form publishing.
- No other changes detected.

- Initial release: Auto-publish Xiaohongshu (小红书) long-form notes on Linux using Chrome attach/VNC.
- Supports publishing via the creator center with title, body file, tags, and real post submission.
- Uses the same Chrome profile and debugging session as Zhihu publish (port 9222).
- Provides CLI flags for title, body, tags, publish (long-form), check, and dry-run.
- Agent workflow outputs machine-readable results with safe publishing defaults.
- Documentation includes setup, verification steps, and usage guidance.
